title: Real Time Diffraction Calculator
content: Understanding the atomic arrangement in materials is crucial in materials science as these atomic configurations strongly influence the properties. Both real-space atomic-resolution imaging and reciprocal-space diffraction patterns of crystalline materials utilizing (scanning) transmission electron microscopy can effectively reveal important crystallographic information [1]. Electron diffraction is thus a widely used technique for material characterization, as it provides insights into lattice parameters, crystal orientation, symmetries, and phase composition. To effectively study the experimental diffraction patterns, we need to compare them to reference patterns, which are typically obtained by simulations based on some crystallographic information. However, tools currently available to simulate electron diffraction patterns either require a paid software package, or require researchers to write their own code, increasing the time required to analyze their experimental diffraction pattern. Building a web-based program with live feedback of crystal orientation and the associated diffraction pattern would benefit researchers who can use an interactive tool to simulate diffraction patterns on the fly during experiments.
